verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a hosted speech-to-text API, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The nearest items are adjacent controls and earn no credit: a private-job option that redacts the input URL and deletes segments after 12 hours, and a blanket policy of never training on customer data. Neither is a user-facing way to turn off usage tracking.
